reason: The named lab and batch report are what I look for, but it's a brand-new product with zero reviews, and I read every review before I buy. I'm not putting $25 to $30 on a brand I can't check yet when I can get magnesium glycinate in a bottle for less.
objection: Foil sachets for a daily capsule feels like a lot of extra packaging waste, and with no reviews I can't tell if the lab report is real or just a nice-looking PDF.
would_change_my_mind: A pile of verified buyer reviews, plus a lab report I can open and match to a batch number, and a cheaper per-day price than a regular bottle or some plain-packaging option.
